corrections.reason: Canonical Ge'ez root text of 1 John 2:8 ('ወውእቱ ፡ አማን ፡ ብክሙ'); the shortened right leg of 4th-order ማ was misread as 1st-order መ.
Ge'ez noun 'ንጽሕ' with 3rd-person masculine plural suffix '-ሆሙ' forms 'ንጽሖሙ' (with 7th-order ሖ, visible in the middle stem ring on the image).
The printed glyph in the Gospel citation ('ወነፍሶ ፡ ሐጕለ') clearly shows the labiovelar ጕ rather than plain ጉ.
